info.title: DingTalk Bridge — Runtime-neutral IM tools
info.description: Account/conversation routed IM. Native UI evidence covers the authorized test group and direct pair; see the acceptance matrix for untested scope. Bundled CLI/gateway/consumer use loopback port 18768. POST JSON bodies are limited to 1 MiB; file/image fields reference permitted server-workspace paths, not inline uploads.

200.description: Route synchronization, scheduler and Stream status, not delivery acceptance. Each route has poll_error and additive poll_error_detail (null or a fixed sanitized diagnostic). HistoryIncomplete means the persisted last_sync is incomplete without a safe continuation, including official partial/failedCount/failures responses; this remains visible after restart or explicit sync. Safe page_limit/result_limit continuation is progress and does not set this error. A subsequent complete or safely continuing sync clears this derived error; independent polling exceptions remain reported. HTTP 200 only means the status response was readable. credential_store_unavailable indicates the pinned DWS could not read its existing macOS Keychain login key; it does not establish token expiry or a locked keychain. Original provider error text is never included. Workspace dws_access reports a persistent circuit: known credential-store failure, subprocess timeout or interrupted ownership suspends future bridge DWS calls, including other configured routes and the image companion. Explicit local operator resume is required; a successful concurrent call cannot clear the latch. It is not a guard for direct runtime CLI invocations or detached official event buses.

413.description: JSON body Content-Length is negative or exceeds 1 MiB.

409.description: artifact_integrity_mismatch: file/image or composition original differs from expected SHA256; this request created no delivery reservation or DWS call. Existing matching keys return their stored receipt.

image.description: Project-relative PNG/JPEG, <=2 MiB, native image only; requires route imageUploadBinary. Upload uncertainty is upload_unknown; no automatic retry or Markdown fallback.

reply_to.description: Optional quote of a message already observed in the selected route with a known sender. Text only. Source is part of the idempotency fingerprint. DWS revalidates source and recipient.

expected_sha256.description: Optional expected SHA256 for file/image. Reject changed bytes before a new delivery reservation; replay an existing matching key from its original receipt even if the producer file changed or disappeared. Text cannot use this field.

composition.description: Experimental literal text plus 1-9 ordered PNG/JPEG references in ONE official Markdown message. Each original <=2 MiB; expected SHA256 required, no bridge compression. Does not promise native image cards, client original retrieval or ordinary file bundles. No automatic fallback/re-upload after unknown outcome.

text.description: Optional literal text; escaped before rendering. Entire generated body, including image paths, <=5120 UTF-16 units.

images.description: Order and duplicate references are preserved; repeated images count toward 9.

path.description: Service-root-relative PNG/JPEG in fixtures/ or local/outbox/; no URLs or traversal.

sha256.description: Expected original byte digest; matching existing key returns stored receipt even after original deletion.

rejection_evidence.description: Optional server-workspace local/ JSON path containing original official length-rejection logs. Explicitly audits an outcome_unknown delivery with no task ID as rejected only after original key, target, command window, text length and persisted payload fingerprint checks. Does not resend; chat attachments cannot certify rejection. See docs/39-rejection-reconciliation-and-feedback.md.

post.summary: Download originals from an observed message; repair creates a new cache attempt

200.description: Resource download ledger: check ok, partial and failedCount. Successful fresh/cache entries are checked for resource identity, uniqueness, path, exact byte count and local SHA256. Partial or missing-resource results are not cached as success; read-only download may be retried.

502.description: DWS failure or invalid attachment manifest/file integrity. Invalid fresh results are not cached. An invalid existing cache requires explicit repair; failed validation of the repair preserves the previous manifest and files.
